title: Shrinking the final Q exchange after the mixed boundary
statement: Let A,d1,d2,b and the explicit middleBoundary and squareInterchange be as in [def-pur-etale-graph-product-shrink-words]. Let sh be shrinkLambda for the composite presentation. Then squareInterchange.hom ≫ sh.hom = middleBoundary.hom ≫ productSquareInterchange.hom. This equation involves neither sourceShrink nor either inverse B exchange.

proof.text: Use the proved private unboundedFormalism and unbounded_sh_comp identification from lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons to obtain associativity for the canonical derived open expansion with equality transports. Apply it to (vh,E,K) and (productE,n,K), using vh_E, E_K, n_K and the two v_j/productE_productK equations from def-pur-etale-graph-product-shrink-words. Cancel the common open expansion. This proves the open_rectangle_tail identity without any proper/open exchange.

Extract horizontal pasting for the particular chosen normalized family by Classical.choose_spec twice in lem-pur-etale-proper-open-exchange-cube. Paste shrink_square before the ambient Q square. Substitute n_K and vg followed by G.e equals productG.e. Cancel the inverse mixed exchange in middleBoundary. Naturality of the ambient Q exchange moves an arbitrary input morphism through the square; the open_rectangle_tail identity and naturality of the open contraction finish exchange_rectangle. This is proved for arbitrary input objects and morphism, independently of graph triangles and final proper maps.

Evaluate at an arbitrary coefficient complex. The two Boolean cases give the same uniform component formula for squareInterchange, by unfolding only that isomorphism and the functor associators. Apply exchange_rectangle with the inverse composite graph triangle as its input morphism. Map the equality by the final proper functor and compose with the final proper compositor. Its naturality moves it through the two shrink factors. Expanding middleBoundary, compositeShrink and productSquareInterchange yields exactly the required equality of components; natural-transformation extensionality concludes.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleGraphProductShrinkSquare
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (d₁ d₂ : EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram f g) (second : Bool) :
    (squareInterchange d₁ d₂ second A).hom ≫ (compositeShrink d₁ d₂ second A).hom =
      (middleBoundary d₁ d₂ second A).hom ≫ (d₁.productSquareInterchange d₂ A).hom
